service_def.name: PrimitivePanTilt
service_def.description: The Primitive Pan Tilt Service is the low level interface to a pan tilt mechanism. Motion of the pan tilt mechanism is accomplished via the Set Pan Tilt Joint Effort message. In this message, each actuator is commanded to move with a percentage of maximum effort. To ensure backward compatibility with 1.0 implementations of this service, it is recommended that this service be co-located on the same component as a Pan Tilt Specification Service.
service_def.assumptions: Messages may be delayed, lost, or reordered.

message_def.name: QueryPanTiltJointEffort
message_def.description: This message shall cause the receiving service to reply to the requestor with a ID 4621h: ReportPanTiltJointEffort message.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: SetPanTiltJointEffort
message_def.description: This message is used to control the two joint actuators for a pan tilt mechanism in an open loop fashion. The command states the percentage level of effort that each actuator should exercise in order to move its corresponding joint.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: ReportPanTiltJointEffort
message_def.description: This message is used to provide the receiver the percent effort that is currently being applied to the two joints of the pan tilt mechanism.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message
